get_sleep_time: get the predicted sleep time for a power in a diplomacy game using the ParlAI sleep classifier
get_recipient: get the predicted recipient for a message from a power using the ParlAI recipient classifier
get_draw_vote_status: get the predicted draw vote status for a power using the ParlAI draw classifier
get_nonsense_status: get whether a potential message is classified as nonsense using the ParlAI nonsense classifier
get_verbose_nonsense_status: get the nonsense classification results from an ensemble of classifiers with detailed per-classifier output
